messages:
alex: T-minus 20 for the routing-v3 rollout. I'm the deploy owner for this window (16:40-17:10 UTC). Plan is staggered canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m. Quick checklist: who is running smoke, who owns rollback, any last config blockers?

maya: I'm smoke lead. I'll run the prod smoke after the 5% canary is healthy. Smoke steps: 1) run `scripts/smoke.sh prod --quick` 2) check /dash/deploy/smoke for errors 3) validate latency P50 < 120ms. I can take verification at +5m after canary.

sam: I'm rollback owner. If we see errors, revert flag `feature.routing_v3` and scale deployment back to blue. Runbook snippet: 
```
# rollback quick
kubectl set env deploy/router feature.routing_v3=false -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/router -n prod
```
I have creds and will coordinate with infra.

jorge: Infra checks done. DB migration is noop for this change, infra health is green across regions, autoscaler rules reviewed (min 2, max 50). No quota issues.

deploy-bot: Pipeline queued: build#8742 started. CI: unit+integration started (ETA ~4m).

alex: Couple of small asks before we go: confirm metrics dashboards link, and that trace sampling is on so we can correlate for 5% traffic. Also disabling long-tail experiments flag temporarily?

maya: dashboards link is https://dash.internal/redwood/deploys/8742. Trace sampling is set to 10% for prod (matching rollout doc). I'll disable the long-tail experiments flag if needed, ping me now.

sam: confirmed I can execute rollback steps. Pager is on. If we get >1% errors on 5% canary for >3m, I trigger rollback.

alex: ok final acks please: reply with `ack` or :thumbsup: so I can start the canary after CI finishes.

maya: ack :thumbsup:

sam: ack

jorge: ack — infra green.

alex: great. CI passed — deploy-bot, start canary when ready.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated at 16:41 UTC. Routing-v3 -> 5% traffic. Observability jobs started.

maya: running quick smoke now. Will update in ~3m.

maya: smoke looks clean (requests OK, p50 98ms). No errors in logs /svc/router (tail).

sam: monitoring error budget and SLOs. All within tolerance.

alex: bumping to 25% in 5 minutes if no regressions. If anything weird, ping @sam immediately.

maya: +1 on ramp. I'll run a deeper smoke at 25%.

alex: thanks everyone — leaving this thread open for any last-minute notes. I'll post final completion once at 100%. :rocket:
